permanent_motion: Subtle, continuous film grain overlay shifting across all layers. Background layers (kraft paper, sepia wash, vignette) have a very slow, imperceptible parallax drift. All foreground icons exhibit a gentle, slow 'breathing' scale animation (1.0 to 1.01 and back) and a slight vertical float.
remotion_implementation_notes: Utilize `AbsoluteFill` for background layering. Apply CSS filters (sepia, contrast, grain) for the visual style. Implement `spring` for entry animations and `loop` with `interpolate` for continuous subtle motions. Text elements can be rendered directly using Remotion's `Text` component with custom fonts and styling. Use `Sequence` and `useCurrentFrame` for precise timing.
potential_pitfalls: Achieving the exact 'Caspian Sepia palette' and 'kraft paper / dark dossier' feel might require fine-tuning CSS filters and color adjustments beyond initial asset generation. Ensuring the 'subtle continuous float' and 'breathing' animations feel organic and not repetitive across multiple elements will require careful easing and timing. Consistent font choice and styling for all text elements to match the documentary aesthetic.
